title: [handoff] repo:objectui PM seat — board state and standing doctrine as of 2026-08-16 ~02:15Z
body:
Handoff from the outgoing `repo:objectui` PM seat (session `session_01RnQd8iMMUwXQEV1crFmQiQ`), wrapped up on the maintainer's instruction (quota). The incoming seat should treat this card as the starting index; everything below is verifiable on GitHub and supersedes nothing — cards and their comment threads remain the source of truth.

## Board state (all verified at wrap-up)

- **`pm:queue` / findings pool / in-flight devs: all ZERO.** No PR is awaiting review, flip, or closeout. No dev worktree carries unpushed work owed to any card.
- **Session-day ledger: 63 PRs merged, zero red merges, zero wrongful closes** (#4713 … #4753). Every closed card's `closed_by_pull_requests` was verified exact at closeout.
- Self-armed timers from the outgoing session: all fired or deleted; none pending.

## Decision box — 10 items awaiting the maintainer, with dispatch plans pre-recorded

| item | ask | seat's recommendation / plan on ruling |
|---|---|---|
| **#4648** GA pin decision | biggest unlock | Rec **A** (reasoned exemptions). Ruling unlocks #4639, #4190, #6275, #4535-item-4, #4668 — dispatch in dependency order |
| #4692 combo drill | A/B/C | Rec **B**; decision-box comment on card |
| #4676 placeholder | A/B/C/D | Rec **C** |
| #4662 engine.* two-locale posture | A/B | Rec **A** (record posture; then one docs card) |
| #4730 `console.objectView.*` 116 keys | delete vs missing-feature | On **A**: fold into a final trim batch together with the deferred key-level trims (`search`/`table`/`report`/`form`, ~40 keys — deliberately NOT dispatched separately). On **B**: file the feature card |
| #4085 / objectstack#8593 / #4036-A | standing | unchanged |
| **#4655 "Version Packages"** | ⛔ | **NEVER merge/queue/auto-merge — maintainer's click only** |
| **#8830** (objectstack lane) | ⛔ | objectstack lane will open its PR; final merge is the maintainer's click. This seat only files issues to objectstack — never claims or dispatches there |

## Archived findings with re-grade triggers (event-driven, do not patrol)

- **#4716** ForgotPasswordForm marker substring — ruled A (leave); triggers on an external consumer report or any touch of that marker logic.
- **#4738** address order follows reader locale — triggers on demand signal; any `countryCode` channel is an upstream spec question (file to objectstack, don't dispatch).
- **#4752** ConfigPanelRenderer undo/redo English defaults — dormant; triggers when a caller wires `onUndo`/`onRedo` or `common.undo`/`common.redo` appears.

## Standing doctrine this seat accumulated (each learned the hard way; details in the linked threads)

1. **No skip-changeset mechanism**: the label exists in the registry but **no gate consumes it** — never apply it (three corrected incidents 2026-08-15; root cause filed as objectstack#8915; also objectstack#8891 for publish-preflight).
2. **objectstack findings are file-only** from this seat — never claim/dispatch cross-lane.
3. **Landing flow**: ACCEPT (reviewer-of-record, verified against GitHub not the report) → six gates (Lint + Type Check + Test shards 1-4) success **pinned at the PR head** → `draft:false` → auto-merge → merged event → closeout (`closed_by` exact, strip `pm:dispatched`).
4. **Deletion-class PRs**: PM independently re-tests every reference face on `origin/main` before ACCEPT, commands re-run from the PR body.
5. **Absence-claim discipline**: never conclude absence from a truncated listing (`head -N`) or an unverified scope (bad pathspec) — **every absence claim needs a positive control first** (two corrected PM errors on 2026-08-15, on the record in PR #4740/#4747 reviews).
6. **Hot-file serial queue**: same-file cards dispatch serially (e.g. #4744 after PR #4745); ten-pack edits in different namespaces may run in parallel with rebase-on-conflict instruction.
7. **Test invocation**: repo-root path-filter form only (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/<pkg>/`); `pnpm --filter <pkg> test` is the documented false-green cwd trap, mechanically blocked.
8. **Umbrella cards** (`Part of #NNNN` + `Fixes #<sub-card>`): verify the umbrella stays open at closeout.
9. **i18n**: repo-wide single-brace convention (`{{x}}` only i18next holes with args); key-choice by measurement (reuse when packs agree 10/10, author new when scoped spellings diverge — PR #4753 models it); value-to-key lookup tables blind BOTH i18n gates — use literal `t()` builders (PR #4751 models it).
10. Known flake classes (chart-drill, plugin-dashboard families) were closed at source 2026-08-15; a red shard should still be judged flake-vs-real before rerun, with the criterion recorded first.

## Ops notes

- All agents share the GitHub identity `yinlianghui` — a claim is assign **plus** a claim comment with the claiming session's ID and branch; re-read comments before writing code.
- The shared account rate-limits under load: back off and retry; a 502 is retryable.
- Issue comments do **not** generate wake events (only PR subscriptions do) — decision-box rulings are found by patrol reads (`list_issues` with `labels=needs-user-decision`, compare `updated_at`), not by waiting.
